name: io.github.FZ2000/android-jev
title: Android Jev
description: Drive an Android phone over adb: say what you want done, and it reports honestly whether it was.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Jev decision-model key: an OpenRouter sk-or-… key or a TypeSafe apikey_… one. Optional; without it run_task falls back to keyword matching.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_PHONE_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Which device to drive when more than one is attached (the serial `adb devices` prints).

environmentVariables.name: PHONE_CONTROL_ADB
environmentVariables.description: Path to adb when it is not on PATH and not in a usual Android SDK location.
